Initiatives to increase the use of renewable energy, reduce energy and material consumption, are in place. This will work towards reducing the impact of the company's operations on the environment as well as build sustainability.
Positive The initiatives taken should see an impact on cost and wastage reduction as well as reduction in carbon footprint.

The company has embarked on a program to enlarge its presence in a larger number of segments (product as well as customer). In addition, greater focus on global markets has also been initiated.

Negative Risk of non achievement of financial goals because of exposure to concentrated business segments and geographies. Positive The initiatives taken by the company provide the opportunity to expand its business into a larger number of segments and geographies.
The recent past has seen significant cost inflation - especially in the cost of raw materials as well as fuel.

The company has been working on measures to contain costs through a program of alternate sourcing, strategic build up of inventory, use of alternate fuels, and internal actions to improve operating efficiencies.

Positive The company has a strong development program in place to address emerging product and market segments. This should have a positive impact on revenue & profitability.

Negative Depressed global economic conditions could have a negative effect on the company's growth ambitions and affect the company's financial performance.

We have increased renewable energy consumption, recycling of the wastes, reduced the usage of fossil fuels - in an effort to contribute to the circular economy.
